lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in a grid-like formation of staggered vertical columns and horizontal rows posterior to the gill slits along the medial flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal linear features on the upper flank exhibiting a sharp vertical luminance gradient with light values on the superior edge and shadow values on the inferior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: A large, dark, elongated silhouette consistent with a remora is attached to the ventrolateral flank posterior to the left pectoral fin.
